_readme: From column 3 of the NJ Abstract of Ratables, "Total Taxable Value of Partial
Exemptions and Abatements". It is the share of a town's assessment base that has
been granted relief and does not pay the general rate.
This matters to everyone else in the town. A municipal levy is a fixed dollar
amount spread across whatever base remains, so removing a slice of the base means
the rest covers the same budget. A high figure is not necessarily bad policy,
abatements are how redevelopment gets financed, but it is never disclosed to the
